messages:
sara: Quick question — pen test scheduled next Wed. Need to confirm log + key preservation for the assessor. How long must logs be retained? Can we provide an ephemeral KMS wrapping key for the assessor? Also need a short chain-of-custody note for the evidence bundle. cc @amanda

jonathan: We can provision per-engagement wrapping keys. Suggested flow: generate a CMK or create a data key and wrap it under a per-assessment CMK, grant the assessor the wrapped data key. Pros: scoped access. Cons: must snapshot logs before any key deletion. Example commands (quick):
```bash
aws kms create-key --description "pt-assessment-1735"
# later
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id <key-id> --pending-window-in-days 7
```

lee: For logs we need immutable exports + retention override. Infra default retention is 180d; external assessor requirement is >=365d. Proposal: set retention to 400d for this bucket, export snapshots of CloudTrail, VPC flow logs, and model inference logs (chat transcripts + trace ids). Also tag exported objects with `pt_id=1735` so they're easy to locate.

amanda: Legal note: external assessors require 12 months retention and a signed LOA that covers data handling, permitted re-use, and destruction schedule. We also require an evidence integrity proof (sha256 manifest) and a transfer log. I can draft the LOA and redaction checklist today. Do not delete keys until integrity is verified.

samir: Runbook for assessor access: create an OIDC-based ephemeral role with max session 4h, require MFA and attestation on each session. Steps: 1) create role with trust to assessor OIDC issuer 2) attach least-privilege policy scoped to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/pt-1735/* 3) enable CloudTrail insights for assume-role events 4) forward assume-role logs to #eng-security for real-time audit. Example assume call:
```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456:role/PT-Assessor-1735 --role-session-name pt-session
```

jonathan: To preserve chain-of-custody we'll produce an evidence manifest with: filenames, S3 paths, sha256 sums, captured_at timestamp, and signer. Minimal manifest header example: 
```json
{ "evidence_id": "pt-1735", "captured_at": "2026-03-18T22:12:00Z", "captured_by": "infra-snapshot-bot" }
```
Include the manifest in the evidence folder and sign the manifest (GPG or internal KMS signing) so we have an auditable fingerprint.

lee: Ops can automate manifest generation and upload to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/pt-1735/manifest.json.gz and enable S3 Object Lock (governance mode) for 400d. We'll need security approval to enable object lock for that bucket. Also will snapshot DB export of evaluation logs (post-processed) and include a readme with capture commands.

amanda: Approved in principle. Legal will prepare LOA + redaction checklist. Reminder: we must avoid sending PII to external assessors unless LOA explicitly allows and engineering has redacted or customer consented.

sara: Action items: jonathan create KMS key + post schedule, lee set retention override + object lock request, samir prep ephemeral role + test assume logging, amanda draft LOA/redaction checklist. Can we target EOD Monday for initial artifacts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jonathan: I'll create the CMK and push steps to infra repo, will ping here with key-id. ETA Mon 10:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Reminder — deploy freeze for PT window starts Tue 00:00 UTC. See #eng-releases for exception process. :no_entry_sign:

samir: I'll run the assume-role test in staging and post sample logs (audit events + peers) once complete.

lee: I'll file the object-lock request and start the exports. Posting the export checklist in the repo by EOD today.

sara: Thanks everyone — please drop short status updates here as you make progress. If anything blocks LOA or retention let @amanda know asap. :thumbsup:
